method: Human semantic cross-check of paired artifacts after generation; exact visual and text hashes must differ while page counts, section order, metrics and obligations match.

checks.scope: 10 numbered sections, five cases, six regional nodes, eight components, 13 scenarios, six packages
five paired figures with matching composition, evidence classes and caution language
eight paired pages in the same order; all 16 pages rendered and visually inspected
two paired boards in the same order; all four boards rendered and visually inspected
same information architecture, evidence, scenarios, implementation and rights links; no remote resources
human fallback, appeal, accessibility, service continuity, anti-displacement, maintenance and exit
